title: Interlock matrix + resolution playbook for cross-team roadmap blockers
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: Roadmap-level initiatives across Eng/Design/Security/Infra lack a consolidated, machine-readable view and an agreed escalation path. This causes missed rollouts, duplicate work, and unclear ownership when inter-team blockers surface.

Goal: Deliver an "interlock matrix" (data model + UI) plus an operational "resolution playbook" that product and program managers use each cycle to triage, resolve, and track dependencies tied to OKRs/initiatives. The deliverable includes a canonical schema, a light-weight Console dashboard prototype, and a documented escalation/resolution workflow.

Scope: 1) Define minimal dependency schema (owner, impacted feature, severity, ETA, mitigation, rollback options). 2) Build a Google Sheet + CSV import for initial ops and a mock Console dashboard for visibility. 3) Ship a playbook outlining cadence (weekly triage, escalation windows), SLAs for responses, and runbook links for Security/Infra checks.

Success metrics: "average time to acknowledge" < 48h for P0/P1 deps; 80% of cycle-level dependencies have an owner assigned at cycle kickoff; reduction in cross-team unblock incidents by 30% quarter-over-quarter.
acceptance_criteria: Data model doc published in Confluence with example payloads (owner, mitigations, ETA, blocker_type)
Console prototype dashboard showing unresolved dependencies by team and by initiative
Automation to ingest CSV/Sheet into the dashboard (manual import is acceptable for MVP)
Resolution playbook published with clear escalation path and contact list for Eng/Design/Security/Infra
Pilot run during one planning cycle with three initiatives across Eng/Design/Security/Infra and follow-up retro
decisions: Use a small canonical schema to avoid heavy engineering: owner, impacted_feature_key, severity (P0..P3), ETA, mitigation, blocker_tags, linked_tickets
Start with manual import (CSV/Google Sheet) rather than building full ingestion API to accelerate pilot
Tie dependency items to OKR initiatives by initiative_key so PMs can filter by objective
Security will own a mandatory checklist item for any dependency tagged 'compliance' with a 72h review SLA for P0/P1
Infra requested that infra-owned blockers be mirrored to existing INF tickets rather than duplicated; we'll maintain single source of truth via linked_tickets
